unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Systems of linear equations
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 8 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: An equation ax + by = c with a and b not both zero is a first-degree (linear) equation in two unknowns.
stages.headlineEnglish: An equation ax + by = c with a and b not both zero is a first-degree (linear) equation in two unknowns.

stages.headline: A solution is a pair (x; y) that makes the equality true; such an equation has infinitely many solutions.
stages.headlineEnglish: A solution is a pair (x; y) that makes the equality true; such an equation has infinitely many solutions.

stages.headline: One unknown can be expressed through the other: from 2x + y = 7 we get y = 7 − 2x; pick any x and find y.
